symptom: `mxcli --mcp <url> exec` of a `create workflow` with notes created the workflow without them and reported success: the header `annotation '…'` (the start's note), `@annotation` before an activity, and `@annotation` before an event sub-process were all dropped.
cause: mapWorkflowActivity built each activity's PED constructor args, and no case passed the activity's Annotation. PED's shared workflowActivityArgs (registry main.js, mxbuild 11.15-11.16) declares `annotation` for every activity and creates a Workflows$Annotation from it. The EventSubProcess constructor's args are name, caption and flow only.
fix: mapWorkflowActivity wraps the per-type mapping and sets `annotation` from the activity's note (BaseWorkflowActivity.GetAnnotation). That covers the start activity, which holds the header note since #1717, and nested flows. A note on an event sub-process is refused, naming it, because its constructor has nowhere to put one.
insight: When the MCP backend lacks a live Studio Pro, the PED constructor's contract is still readable from mxbuild's modeler/ide-client/registry/main.js: grep for the args object (here `workflowActivityArgs`) and its implementation to see which keys a constructor takes and what it creates. A wrapper that adds a shared key to every mapped element is the single place that cannot miss a type the per-type switch grows later. Not yet verified against a running Studio Pro: whether the note is drawn on the canvas.
test: mdl/backend/mcp/workflow_notes_1741_test.go (start, activity and nested notes reach the mapped args, no annotation key for an activity without one, an event sub-process note is refused); both failed with workflow.go reverted
